mapper.insert: INSERT INTO messaging_outbox (message_id, message_code, envelope, status, available_at, attempt_count, lease_id, lease_until, last_error, sent_at, version) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{messageCode}, #{envelope}, #{status}, #{availableAt}, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0)
mapper.select: WITH candidate AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT message_id, version, CASE WHEN status = 'SENDING' THEN lease_until ELSE available_at END AS claim_at FROM messaging_outbox WHERE (status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND available_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'SENDING' AND lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY claim_at, message_id LIMIT #{limit} ), leased AS ( UPDATE messaging_outbox AS message SET status = 'SENDING', attempt_count = message.attempt_count + 1, lease_id = #{leaseId}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, last_error = NULL, version = message.version + 1 FROM candidate WHERE message.message_id = candidate.message_id AND message.version = candidate.version AND ((message.status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND message.available_at <= #{now}) OR (message.status = 'SENDING' AND message.lease_until <= #{now})) RETURNING message.message_id, message.message_code, message.envelope, message.attempt_count, message.version, candidate.claim_at ) SELECT FROM leased ORDER BY claim_at, message_id
